name: Kreeli – Transcription
description: Live transcription of microphone and system sound with speaker recognition and summary.
long_description: Transcribes meetings from microphone and system sound live – only with the consent of all participants. Speech recognition by a connected provider (OpenAI, Gemini, Groq, Mistral, Deepgram …) or completely offline with Whisper local. Speaker recognition, optional encrypted speaker profiles (with their own notice, Art. 9 GDPR) and a summary by an assistant. Only text is stored, never the recording.
author: KuroShiro
